notes: A dependency audit: features that secretly needed extra software now work out of the box. Reminders understand real English times (“tomorrow at 9am”, “friday 5pm”, “in two hours”) with no extra libraries; voice notes and spoken replies use what your Mac already has (local model server for transcription, macOS's own voice for replies); QR codes, big-letter ASCII art, link summaries and PDF attachments are all built in — no setup, no keys, no surprises.
notes_zh: 一次依赖体检：那些暗地里需要额外软件的功能，现在开箱即用。提醒功能直接理解真实英语时间（“明天上午9点”“周五下午5点”“两小时后”），不再依赖额外库；语音转文字用本机模型服务器，语音回复用 macOS 自带嗓音；二维码、大字 ASCII、链接摘要、PDF 附件解析全部内置——无需配置、无需密钥。
